title: Speaker card
description: Speaker card in the house look: a big photo beside the event, date, time and venue, then the talk title (a placeholder until it's set), the speaker's name and role. Source: scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html (Prague Crawl 2027, May 13, 2027, Spojka Events, Prague; citing praguecrawl.com).

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: One or two words: Speaker, Keynote, Panelist

fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: Square portrait, face centred, at least 1000 px wide

fields.label: Talk title
fields.hint: Up to two lines; about 50 characters reads best. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: Role
fields.hint: Job title and company, about 40 characters

fields.label: Time
fields.hint: Start time and time zone, e.g. 11:10 CET. Leave the brackets until it's known
